_note: Lib-agnostic source catalog extracted from the S578 prototype. Nested keys work as-is with next-intl namespaces or a plain lookup helper. {name} is a runtime interpolation (the channel name). Keep operator-facing strings ONLY here; no string ships as a literal in the UI.

stage1.title: Sign in to your rental sites
stage1.sub: Sign in to each site one time. Then you post everywhere from here.
stage1.kindLogin: You use your own account here. We write the ad and save the link. Vacantless never signs in as you.

status.linkedSub: We post it when you press Post.
status.notLinkedSub: Sign in once and we post here for you.
status.mlsOnlySub: Your real estate agent posts here. We give them the details.
status.connectedNeedsAuthSub: Signed in as {label}. Allow us to post here.
status.checkingSub: We are checking your {name} account. It takes under a minute.
status.deadSessionSub: Your {name} sign-in ended: {reason}. Sign in again.
status.linkedSubLogin: Your account is on file. We write the ad and save the link.
status.notLinkedSubLogin: Tell us which account you use. Then we write the ad.
status.selfPostSub: Free. We write the ad. You post it from your own {name} account.

stage1.igNote: Needs a Facebook Page with a linked Instagram Business account.

reason.cloudflare: the site asked for a human check
reason.captcha: the site asked for a human check

cap.kijijiTierUnknown: Tell us if this is a personal or business Kijiji account.
cap.rentalsUsed: Free for 3 listings. You use {used} of 3.
cap.rentalsReached: You use all 3 free listings. Turn one off first.
cap.zumperUsed: Free for 5 listings. You use {used} of 5.
cap.zumperReached: You use all 5 free listings. Take one down first.

cost.kijijiTierUnknown: Tell us if this is a personal or business Kijiji account.
cost.kijijiNext: Free for 1 ad. The next one is {price}.
cost.kijijiPerAd: {price} per ad, paid at the last step.
cost.kijijiPerExtraAd: {price} per extra ad, paid at the last step.
cost.spendSuffix: Set your limit before a paid post.

stage2.title: Tell us about your rental
stage2.sub: Give us the facts one time. We fill every site for you. Pick one way to begin.
stage2.cardEmailBody: Send any notes or a draft to your private Vacantless address.
stage2.cardDocBody: Drag in an old lease, a PDF brochure, or an MLS sheet.
stage2.cardManualBody: Fill a simple form by hand.
stage2.readTitle: What the computer has read so far
stage2.pickPrompt: Pick one way above. The details appear here.

sheet.title: Answer these once
sheet.sub: Every rental site asks the same questions. Answer them once and we fill every ad.
sheet.requiredSub: Your sites need these answers before they take the ad.
sheet.answerOnceTitle: Answer once so we get it right
sheet.answerOnceSub: Sites ask these on every ad. We would post the grey answer today.
sheet.recommendedSub: Optional, but ads with these get more replies.
sheet.orgReadOnly: Ask your admin to change this.
sheet.savedComplete: All answered. Every site you chose has what it needs.
sheet.requiredLeft: {count, plural, =0 {No required answers left} one {# required answer left} other {# required answers left}}
sheet.answerOnceLeft: {count, plural, =0 {} one {# to answer once} other {# to answer once}}
sheet.nextBlocked: Answer the required questions to continue.
sheet.mirrored: We also saved the building's standard answers on this listing.

stage3.title: Choose and post
stage3.sub: Check it once. Then post to every site you signed in to.
stage3.onlyLinked: We post only to the sites you signed in to. The rest wait.
stage3.sending: Posting now. Please keep this screen open.
stage3.allDone: All done. Your listing is live everywhere it can be.

stage4.title: After it is live
stage4.sub: Every inquiry comes back to one place. We take your ads down when the home is rented.
stage4.leadsBody: Every reply from every website comes back to one place.
stage4.takedownTitle: Ads come down when you rent
stage4.takedownBody: When the home is rented, we take each ad down for you.
stage4.markLeasedHint: This turns on soon. For now, mark it rented on its page.
stage4.leasedDone: Rented. Your ads are marked taken down.
